evidence_excerpts: Every animation was shown at one of 23 refresh rates from 50 Hz to 165 Hz, and the results report that higher refresh rates imply less-perceivable motion artifacts while differences above 100 Hz are increasingly difficult to observe.
text: Subjective motion-quality measurements from 50 Hz to 165 Hz show that higher refresh rates improve perceived quality, but gains become harder to observe above roughly 100 Hz.
